GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
